Chart.js 4.4.7 (UMD build) — vendored for the admin analytics dashboard.
Source: https://www.chartjs.org/ · https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.min.js
License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2014-2024 Chart.js Contributors).
Loaded lazily only on /admin; if it fails to load the dashboard keeps its KPI cards and
shows a per-chart fallback message.
